name: gh-cli-code-review-environment
description: A local GitHub CLI review runtime with readable workspace files, supplied issue and PR context, and a supplied repository contract.

tools.read_pr_diff: Reads the local pull request diff when the workspace is readable; adds diff_read.
tools.read_repo_contract: Reads the supplied repository contract when the workspace is readable; adds contract_read.
tools.deliver_review: Delivers a static code review after the diff and repository contract have both been read; adds review_delivered.
tools.run_go_tests: Runs Go tests from the readable workspace and records the observed result; adds tests_observed.
